name: American Alloy Fabrication Inc
old_description: American Alloy Fabrication, Inc. (AAFI) has been serving customers with metal fabricated components for more than 35 years. Our success is a result of our continued investment in the latest manufacturing technologies as well as our aggressive focus on quality, lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement.
about:
American Alloy Fabrication, Inc. (AAFI) began in 1980 as a one‑man welding shop in Huntsville, Alabama, founded to serve local industries with precision welding services.

By 1987 the company had incorporated and moved into a new facility that has since been expanded multiple times. Today AAFI operates as a vertically integrated contract manufacturer offering sheet metal fabrication (laser cutting, CNC turret punching, CNC forming), CNC and manual machining, welding (MIG, TIG, spot, robotic), metal finishing, deburring, polishing, mechanical assembly, and packaging, crating and logistics support. The shop also provides design‑for‑manufacturability assistance, prototype development, production manufacturing and complete project management.

The company’s customer base spans diverse industries; its first major contract came from a local engine manufacturer that needed a reusable shipping rack, a project that launched AAFI into large‑scale contract manufacturing. Since then the firm has supplied fabricated parts, industrial enclosures, custom weldments and mechanical assemblies to a range of industrial clients.

AAFI emphasizes continuous investment in advanced manufacturing technology and a quality system that consistently achieves above 95 % acceptance and on‑time delivery. Inspection capabilities include coordinate measuring machines, optical comparators and laser scanners. The company’s stated goal is to build long‑term partnerships by acting as an extension of its customers’ organizations.
